<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>TaskFlow · T41 · Inicio visual y estabilidad offline</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#030814;color:#fff;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
body{min-height:100dvh}
#boot{position:fixed;inset:0;isolation:isolate;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#030814;overflow:hidden}
#boot:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6%;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/cover no-repeat;filter:blur(24px) brightness(.46)}
/* T37 · Referencia de carga 98663 con porcentaje y barra de progreso reales. */
.tf-art-wrap{position:relative;flex:none;aspect-ratio:9/16;width:min(100vw,56.25dvh);max-height:100dvh;container-type:inline-size;box-shadow:0 10px 50px #0008}
.tf-art{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;pointer-events:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
.tf-live-progress{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:12.96%;top:54.82%;width:74.42%;height:3.20%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3.7%;padding:0 2%;border:1px solid #123d6a;border-radius:3cqw;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#042b41,#08152f);box-shadow:inset 0 0 9px #087ac044,0 0 7px #087ac022;pointer-events:none}
.tf-live-progress-track{flex:0 0 86%;height:2.9cqw;max-height:25px;min-height:6px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(0,9,30,.97);border:1px solid rgba(35,103,167,.65);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
.tf-live-progress-fill{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:inherit;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left center;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0be8ec 0%,#1bd8ee 24%,#546cfd 49%,#d246f2 74%,#ffbd81 100%);box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(32,221,248,.44);will-change:transform}
.tf-live-progress-label{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:clamp(9px,2.8cqw,24px);font-weight:750;line-height:1;text-align:center;color:#e5efff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 3px #111c37}
.tf-boot-panel{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:max(20px,calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));width:min(90vw,440px);padding:14px 18px;text-align:center;background:rgba(3,9,23,.96);border:1px solid rgba(61,208,216,.48);border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 14px 45px #0009;display:none}
#boot.error .tf-boot-panel{display:block}
#msg{font-size:14px;font-weight:750;margin:0 0 6px;color:#9ff9f2}
#detail{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#d1e0ef;max-height:100px;overflow:auto;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#retry{margin:12px 0 0;border:1px solid #56e3d6;background:#23d7c6;color:#031c23;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 20px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.tf-fallback{display:none;margin:12px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#a1ddd9}
.tf-fallback a{color:#a1fff4}
#boot.error .tf-fallback{display:block}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
button,a,[role="button"]{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}

/* T10 · Restricciones de interacción solicitadas para el contenido del sistema. */
html,body{overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;touch-action:pan-x pan-y!important}
body,body :not(input):not(textarea):not([contenteditable="true"]){-webkit-user-select:none!important;user-select:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important}
input,textarea,[contenteditable="true"]{-webkit-user-select:text!important;user-select:text!important;touch-action:manipulation!important}
img,svg,video,canvas{-webkit-user-drag:none!important;user-drag:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important}
button,a,[role="button"]{touch-action:manipulation!important;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
</style>

function advanceLoadingProgress(now){

async function fetchText(url){
  const ctl=new AbortController();
  const timer=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),5200);
  try{

    if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status+' al solicitar '+url);

const TF_T10_PROTECT_HEAD="<style id='tfT10NoCopyZoomCss'>\n/* T10 · Restricciones de interacción solicitadas para el contenido del sistema. */\nhtml,body{overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;touch-action:pan-x pan-y!important}\nbody,body :not(input):not(textarea):not([contenteditable=\"true\"]){-webkit-user-select:none!important;user-select:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important}\ninput,textarea,[contenteditable=\"true\"]{-webkit-user-select:text!important;user-select:text!important;touch-action:manipulation!important}\nimg,svg,video,canvas{-webkit-user-drag:none!important;user-drag:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important}\nbutton,a,[role=\"button\"]{touch-action:manipulation!important;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}\n</style><script id='tfT10NoCopyZoomJs'>(function(){'use strict';if(window.__tfNoCopyZoomT10)return;window.__tfNoCopyZoomT10=true;\nvar editable=function(el){return !!(el&&el.closest&&el.closest('input,textarea,[contenteditable=\"true\"]'))};\n['contextmenu','copy','cut','dragstart'].forEach(function(type){document.addEventListener(type,function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()},true)});\ndocument.addEventListener('selectstart',function(e){if(!editable(e.target)){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()}},true);\n['gesturestart','gesturechange','gestureend'].forEach(function(type){document.addEventListener(type,function(e){if(e.cancelable)e.preventDefault()}, {capture:true,passive:false})});\ndocument.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){if(e.ctrlKey&&e.cancelable)e.preventDefault()},{capture:true,passive:false});\ndocument.addEventListener('dblclick',function(e){if(!editable(e.target)&&e.cancelable)e.preventDefault()},true);\ndocument.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(!(e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey))return;var k=String(e.key||'').toLowerCase();if(['c','x','s','p','u','+','=','-','0'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()}},true);\n})();<\/script>";

const TF_PROTOCOL_T12_CSS="/* TaskFlow T12 · La X aparece únicamente al completar el protocolo ya iniciado. */\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-locked .v85-routine-modal-head > .window-close,\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-locked .v85-routine-modal-head > [aria-label=\"Cerrar\"]{\n  display:none!important;\n  visibility:hidden!important;\n  pointer-events:none!important;\n}\n#windowContainer.tf-protocol-t12-finished .v85-routine-modal-head > .window-close{\n  visibility:visible!important;\n  pointer-events:auto!important;\n}\n";
const TF_PROTOCOL_T12_JS="/* TaskFlow T12 · Bloqueo de salida exclusivamente mientras un protocolo iniciado esté incompleto.\n * No modifica misiones, sus requisitos, su progreso ni sus datos.\n */\n(function(){\n  'use strict';\n  if(window.__tfProtocolLockT12)return;\n  window.__tfProtocolLockT12=true;\n\n  const PANEL='#windowContent';\n  const ROUTINE='.v96-mentalist-scroll,.v97-routine-scroll';\n  const START=/(?:^|\\s)(?:comenzar|iniciar)\\s+(?:el\\s+)?(?:protocolo|rutina)(?:\\s|$)/;\n  let active=null;\n  let pending=false;\n\n  function normal(value){\n    return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g,'')\n      .toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();\n  }\n  function frame(){return document.getElementById('windowContainer')}\n  function panel(){return document.getElementById('windowContent')}\n  function getRoutine(){\n    const f=frame(),p=panel();\n    if(!f||!p||!f.classList.contains('open'))return null;\n    const scroll=p.querySelector(ROUTINE);\n    if(!scroll)return null;\n    const h=p.querySelector('.v85-routine-modal-copy h2');\n    const title=normal(h&&h.textContent)||normal(p.querySelector('.v85-routine-modal-copy')?.textContent);\n    const pill=p.querySelector('.v85-routine-progress-pill');\n    const txt=String(pill&&pill.textContent||'');\n    const m=txt.match(/(\\d+)\\s*\\/\\s*(\\d+)/);\n    let done=m?Number(m[1]):-1;\n    let total=m?Number(m[2]):-1;\n    if(total<=0){\n      // Únicamente como respaldo cuando el núcleo no presenta contador numérico.\n      const mission=scroll.querySelectorAll('.v94-mentalist-step,.v69-routine-item,.v85-sung-item,.v83-legal-item');\n      if(mission.length){total=mission.length;done=Array.from(mission).filter(x=>x.classList.contains('done')||x.classList.contains('completed')||x.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true').length;}\n    }\n    if(total<=0 || done<0)return null;\n    return {f,p,scroll,title,done,total,completed:done>=total};\n  }\n  function sameRoutine(r){\n    return !!(active&&r&&r.title===active.title&&r.total===active.total);\n  }\n  function update(){\n    if(!active)return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(!sameRoutine(r))return;\n    const lock=!r.completed;\n    active.completed=r.completed;\n    // Evitar mutaciones DOM innecesarias y no interferir con las tarjetas.\n    if(r.f.classList.contains('tf-protocol-t12-locked')!==lock)\n      r.f.classList.toggle('tf-protocol-t12-locked',lock);\n    if(r.f.classList.contains('tf-protocol-t12-finished')!==!lock)\n      r.f.classList.toggle('tf-protocol-t12-finished',!lock);\n  }\n  function schedule(){\n    if(pending)return;\n    pending=true;\n    requestAnimationFrame(function(){pending=false;update()});\n  }\n  function locked(){\n    if(!active)return false;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(sameRoutine(r)){\n      if(r.completed){update();return false;}\n      return true;\n    }\n    // Conservar la protección ante una transición accidental mientras el protocolo sigue activo.\n    return !active.completed;\n  }\n  function start(button){\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(!r||!r.p.contains(button))return false;\n    if(!START.test(normal(button.textContent)))return false;\n    active={title:r.title,total:r.total,completed:r.completed};\n    update();\n    return true;\n  }\n  function isExit(target,r){\n    if(!target||!target.closest)return false;\n    if(target.closest('#windowContainer .window-close,#windowContainer [data-close],#windowContainer [aria-label*=\"Cerrar\"],#windowContainer [aria-label*=\"cerrar\"]'))return true;\n    return !!(r&&!r.p.contains(target));\n  }\n  // Evitar cierres lanzados por la aplicación sin pasar por el botón de la X.\n  // Cuando el 100 % se alcanza, se delega intacto al cierre original.\n  try{\n    if(typeof window.closeWindow==='function'&&!window.closeWindow.__tfProtocolGuardT12){\n      const nativeClose=window.closeWindow;\n      const guardedClose=function(){\n        if(locked())return;\n        return nativeClose.apply(this,arguments);\n      };\n      guardedClose.__tfProtocolGuardT12=true;\n      window.closeWindow=guardedClose;\n    }\n  }catch(error){console.warn('TaskFlow: protección de cierre parcial',error)}\n  // El listener en window/captura se ejecuta ANTES de los cierres y navegaciones de otros módulos.\n  window.addEventListener('click',function(event){\n    const target=event.target;\n    const button=target&&target.closest&&target.closest('button,[role=\"button\"]');\n    if(button && start(button))return;\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(target,r)){\n      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },true);\n  window.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const k=event.key;\n    const exitKey=k==='Escape'||k==='BrowserBack'||k==='GoBack'||\n      (k==='Backspace'&&!event.target.closest?.('input,textarea,[contenteditable=\"true\"]'))||\n      (event.altKey&&(k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='Left'));\n    if(exitKey){event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();}\n  },true);\n  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(event.target,r)){\n      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },true);\n  document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    const r=getRoutine();\n    if(isExit(event.target,r)){\n      if(event.cancelable)event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\n    }\n  },{capture:true,passive:false});\n  // El navegador puede autorizar o ignorar el diálogo al abandonar la página.\n  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(event){\n    if(!locked())return;\n    event.preventDefault();event.returnValue='';\n  });\n  const p=panel();\n  if(p){\n    const observer=new MutationObserver(schedule);\n    observer.observe(p,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});\n  }\n  const f=frame();\n  if(f){\n    const obs=new MutationObserver(schedule);\n    obs.observe(f,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});\n  }\n  // No se guarda nada en localStorage ni se modifica el estado de las misiones.\n  window.__tfProtocolLockT12Inspect=function(){\n    const r=getRoutine();return {started:!!active,locked:locked(),complete:!!(r&&r.completed),done:r?r.done:null,total:r?r.total:null};\n  };\n})();\n";
const TF_CLOCK_T13_JS="/* T36 · Un solo reloj y progreso del mismo ciclo diario, 01:00 de Guatemala. */\n(function(){\n'use strict';\nif(window.__tfSmoothDailyCountdownT18)return;\nwindow.__tfSmoothDailyCountdownT18=true;\nconst ELEMENT='resetCountdownTime',DAY=86400000,GT_OFFSET=21600000;\nlet timer=0,displayed=null,lastText='',active=true,lastFill='';\nconst pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');\nfunction cycle(now){\n const g=new Date(now-GT_OFFSET);\n let reset=Date.UTC(g.getUTCFullYear(),g.getUTCMonth(),g.getUTCDate(),7,0,0);\n if(now>=reset)reset+=DAY;\n const elapsed=Math.max(0,Math.min(DAY,now-(reset-DAY)));\n return {remaining:Math.max(0,Math.ceil((reset-now)/1000)),progress:elapsed/DAY,reset};\n}\nfunction paint(seconds,progress){\n const el=document.getElementById(ELEMENT);if(!el)return;\n const text=pad(Math.floor(seconds/3600))+':'+pad(Math.floor(seconds%3600/60))+':'+pad(seconds%60);\n if(text!==lastText||el.textContent!==text){el.textContent=text;lastText=text}\n const fill=(progress*100).toFixed(7)+'%';\n if(fill!==lastFill||el.style.getPropertyValue('--tf36-cycle-fill')!==fill){el.style.setProperty('--tf36-cycle-fill',fill);lastFill=fill}\n}\nfunction tick(){\n timer=0;if(document.hidden||!active)return;\n const now=Date.now(),state=cycle(now),target=state.remaining;\n if(displayed===null||target>displayed)displayed=target;else if(displayed>target)displayed-=1;\n paint(displayed,state.progress);\n timer=setTimeout(tick,displayed>target?110:Math.max(120,1010-(Date.now()%1000)));\n}\nfunction restart(){if(timer)clearTimeout(timer);timer=0;if(document.hidden){active=false;return}active=true;displayed=null;tick()}\ndocument.addEventListener('visibilitychange',restart,{passive:true});\nwindow.addEventListener('pageshow',restart,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('focus',restart,{passive:true});\nif(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',restart,{once:true});else restart();\n})();\n";
const TF_HOME_T14_CSS="/* TaskFlow T14 · Inicio visual basado en 96380.png\n   Scope: solo dashboard, cabecera y sus tarjetas. Ningún dato, misión o canje cambia. */\n:root{--tf14-streak-flare:url(\"data:image/webp;base64,\");--tf14-hourglass:url(\"data:image/webp;base64,
